# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Cold War: Spain 1970 national programme.
## Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_SPR_generator (spr_build.py) from the approved design (claude/mdcw_spr_1970_focus_tree_data.json).
## Edit the generator or the design, not this file. Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SPR }
				SPR = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
							has_focus_tree = COLDWAR_SPR_1970_focus
						}
						COLDWAR_SPR_initialize = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly_SPR = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_initialized }
				COLDWAR_SPR_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = SPR has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SPR_initialized }
				COLDWAR_SPR_update_party_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
